name: Basis compression after spot inflow
hypothesis: Buy discounted perpetual and hedge spot where feasible after confirmed independent spot inflow and initial basis convergence.
spec: Setup: New spot demand may close a negative derivative basis. Entry: Buy discounted perpetual and hedge spot where feasible after confirmed independent spot inflow and initial basis convergence. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on basis normalization or renewed divergence. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable.
